eval-2 (runtime tool selection, judgment) is non-discriminating: both configs correctly steered away from type-state and rejected the unsafe idea. Keep it as a regression guardrail, or swap for a harder judgment case next iteration.

eval-1 (job lifecycle) non-discriminating at the assertion level — both stored state data inline with no Option+unreachable. The with-skill run verified more negative-compile cases (higher tokens/time).

Cost: with-skill runs spent more tokens and time (read the skill, ran rustc to verify, checked negative cases). Acceptable for a correctness-focused skill; the verification rigor is a feature, not waste.
